states.label: Ended
states.sublabel: Terminal; create new for future work

transitions.label: End
transitions.note: Confirm future NotStarted archival when required.

transitions.label: Resume
transitions.note: Skip paused dates when advancing cursor.

cards.title: Ended is terminal
items: Pause or Resume from Ended returns 422 without changing the series, version or occurrence rows.
Start a new series for future recurring work. Existing started/Done Tasks are preserved.

cards.title: No-op and access rules
items: Resume while Active, Pause while Paused and repeated End with the current version are no-ops.
Ownership and version checks remain authoritative: foreign IDs return 404; stale versions return 409.

cards.title: Committed lifecycle scope
items: Source snapshot 2e9e68d: personal TaskSeries only; Teamwork has a separate completion-driven repeat path.
Active series materialize on scheduled jobs or due reads. Paused/Ended series do not generate new occurrences.
